paragraphs: TiDB (/’taɪdiːbi:/, "Ti" stands for Titanium) is an open-source, cloud-native, distributed SQL database designed for high availability, horizontal and vertical scalability, strong consistency, and high performance.
features: Distributed Transactions: TiDB uses a two-phase commit protocol to ensure ACID compliance, providing strong consistency. Transactions span multiple nodes, and TiDB's distributed nature ensures data correctness even in…

Horizontal and Vertical Scalability: TiDB can be scaled horizontally by adding more nodes or vertically by increasing resources of existing nodes, all without downtime. TiDB's architecture separates computing from…

High Availability: Built-in Raft consensus protocol ensures reliability and automated failover. Data is stored in multiple replicas, and transactions are committed only after writing to the majority of replicas,…

Hybrid Transactional/Analytical Processing (HTAP): TiDB provides two storage engines: TiKV, a row-based storage engine, and TiFlash, a columnar storage engine. TiFlash uses the Multi-Raft Learner protocol to replicate…

Cloud-Native: TiDB can be deployed in public clouds, on-premises, or natively in Kubernetes. TiDB Operator helps manage TiDB on Kubernetes, automating cluster operations, while TiDB Cloud provides a fully-managed…
